name: Carbon laser peel (Hollywood peel)
lead: The carbon laser peel, often marketed as the Hollywood peel, is a clinic laser treatment aimed at smoother skin texture, smaller-looking pores and a brighter complexion with little downtime. A carbon-based lotion is applied to the face and then treated with laser pulses; the lotion is said to absorb the energy and lift debris and surface skin.

Laser resurfacing as a category is described in medical references as controlled wounding that prompts skin to regenerate, using ablative, non-ablative and fractional lasers.[1] Peel-style treatments of the surface skin more broadly are covered under chemical peels.[2] The specific carbon-lotion procedure has no published trials in the sources reviewed.

chain: Carbon lotion applied and laser pulses delivered
Surface skin and oil are exfoliated
angle.text: Clinics offer it for fresher, smoother-looking skin and tighter-looking pores with minimal downtime. People book it before events for an immediate glow.

paras: Practitioners describe the treatment as a carbon lotion plus laser session, with a brief appointment and quick return to normal activity. Laser resurfacing in general ranges from ablative lasers like CO2 and Er:YAG to non-ablative and fractional devices.[1]
No studies found. Related research on laser resurfacing and chemical peels is described generally in medical references.[1][2]

Laser resurfacing in general carries risks of scarring, hyperpigmentation, acne flares and herpes outbreaks.[1] Chemical peels can cause redness, pigment changes and photosensitivity, rising with depth.[2]
It is discussed alongside other skin-texture treatments, with popular interest tied to celebrity-style red-carpet skin.

card.summary: A carbon-lotion and laser clinic treatment promoted for smoother texture, smaller-looking pores and glow.
card.aka: Carbon peel, Hollywood peel, carbon laser facial
card.note: Laser skin treatments can cause redness, pigment changes and rarely scarring.

quick.overview:
The carbon laser peel is a short clinic treatment where a carbon lotion is applied to the face and laser pulses are passed over it. It is offered for smoother texture and a brighter look.

It is marketed as the Hollywood peel for its quick pre-event glow.
quick.mechanism: The carbon lotion is said to absorb laser energy, exfoliating surface skin and debris. Specific published trials of the procedure are not available.
quick.risks: Laser resurfacing can cause redness, pigment changes, and in rare cases scarring or acne and herpes flares.
